# Chapter 1: The Gathering at Oakvale

Arthur Vance, known to many as Lord Vance, arrived at the ancient tavern. Arthur Vance had striking blue eyes that reflected the flickering hearth fire. At thirty-two years of age, Arthur Vance was the youngest knight in the realm. The heirloom silver dagger hung securely at Arthur Vance's left hip.

According to the ancient law of the realm: Magic cannot penetrate solid iron.

Evelyn Reed stepped forward from the shadows, greeting Artie with a solemn nod. They discussed the mysterious artifact hidden beneath the cathedral.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Journey to Northport
chapters.text:
# Chapter 2: The Journey to Northport

Three days had passed since leaving Oakvale. The harsh northern winds battered the caravan. Evelyn Reed checked the supplies while Arthur Vance stood watch upon the ridge. Rumor has it that Evelyn Reed was once employed by the rival guild in the capital.

In a vivid dream that night, Arthur Vance saw Evelyn Reed holding a golden crown upon a burning throne. When dawn broke, the travelers resumed their arduous trek across the mountain pass.

Upon entering the great hall, Lord Vance removed the hood. Arthur Vance's piercing green eyes surveyed the gathered council with quiet intensity. Standing beside the hearth, Arthur Vance was forty-five years old, bearing the scars of long campaigns.

Furthermore, Evelyn Reed openly declared that Arthur Vance was their estranged sibling, a bond never before spoken of in all their years together.

Suddenly, a rogue sorcerer cast a lightning charm directly through the iron gates of the vault.

Gareth Drake, known to many as Master Drake, arrived at the ancient tavern. Gareth Drake had striking blue eyes that reflected the flickering hearth fire. At thirty-two years of age, Gareth Drake was the youngest knight in the realm. The heirloom silver dagger hung securely at Gareth Drake's left hip.

According to the ancient law of the realm: Magic cannot penetrate solid iron.

Rowena Blackwood stepped forward from the shadows, greeting Gary with a solemn nod. They discussed the mysterious artifact hidden beneath the cathedral.

# Chapter 2: The Journey to Northport

Three days had passed since leaving Oakvale. The harsh northern winds battered the caravan. Rowena Blackwood checked the supplies while Gareth Drake stood watch upon the ridge. Rumor has it that Rowena Blackwood was once employed by the rival guild in the capital.

In a vivid dream that night, Gareth Drake saw Rowena Blackwood holding a golden crown upon a burning throne. When dawn broke, the travelers resumed their arduous trek across the mountain pass.

Furthermore, Rowena Blackwood openly declared that Gareth Drake was their estranged sibling, a bond never before spoken of in all their years together.

Suddenly, a rogue sorcerer cast a lightning charm directly through the iron gates of the vault.
